label: Week 39, 2026
recap:
Week 39, 2026 was quiet, with two bill movements recorded and no case updates or federal documents. Activity was split between California and the District of Columbia, one bill movement each. The two tracked bills touched three themes: health care, infrastructure and energy, and transparency and disclosure. Each theme appeared once, and no unthemed bills were recorded.

The health care theme covered clinical decision support, utilization review, mental health chatbots, and AI in diagnosis or coverage decisions. Infrastructure and energy covered data centers, the power they draw, and local hosting costs. Transparency and disclosure covered labeling AI-generated output, telling people when they are talking to a machine, and impact assessments. Because only two bill movements occurred, the week's activity remained narrow.
